dotnettesttoolmatcher

Open in playgroundFile on GitHubHistory

Install: ci-doctor matchers add official/dotnet_test

matchers/dotnet/dotnet_test/matcher.yaml

id: dotnet_test
role: tool
classification: [dotnet, test]
description: '`dotnet test`: xunit/nunit `[FAIL]` markers and the `Failed!` summary line.'
pattern: '\[FAIL\]|^\s*Failed\s+\S+\s+\[\d|^Failed!\s+-\s+Failed:'
before: 1
after: 12
